actions.instruction: Hey, can you create a note in the Shared folder with a summary of today's product sync meeting? Key points: calendar integration approved, dark mode deprioritized, launch target is April.
Could you add a note in Projects about the new CI pipeline requirements? We need GitHub Actions with lint, type-check, and E2E stages. Target: have it running by end of sprint.
Please create a meeting note in Meetings for the API design review we just had. Decisions: REST for v1, pagination via cursor, rate limit 200 req/min for Pro tier.
Can you jot down a note in the Shared folder about the new brand voice guidelines we discussed? Key rule: no jargon like 'revolutionary' or 'disruptive'. Tone should be technical but approachable.
Create a note in Projects documenting the Slack integration architecture. We're using Slack's Events API with webhook verification, and messages get routed to our agent pipeline.
Please add a note in Meetings capturing the customer feedback from today's session. Top 3 requests: Slack integration, better search, and team workspaces.
Can you create a note in the Projects folder for the database migration plan? We're moving from single-region Neon to multi-region with EU-West read replicas. Target completion: Q4 2026.
Add a quick note in Shared about our Product Hunt launch checklist. Items: screenshots ready, demo video recorded, blog post scheduled, team members lined up for upvotes on launch day.
Please create a note in Projects summarizing the PostHog vs Mixpanel evaluation. PostHog: self-hosted, flexible, $0. Mixpanel: best event tracking, $800/mo. Recommendation: Mixpanel for now.
Create a meeting note in Meetings for the weekly standup. Updates: Mike finished the auth refactor, Lisa is starting the Slack integration, Tom is on PTO this week.
Can you add a note in Projects with the new feature flag naming convention? Format: team-feature-variant, e.g., platform-dark-mode-v2. All flags go through LaunchDarkly.
Please create a note in Shared about the upcoming podcast appearance on The AI Native Show. Recording April 22, topic is building trust in AI agents. Alex should prep talking points by April 20.
Create a note in Meetings documenting the design review decisions. We chose bottom nav for mobile, card-based home screen, and swipe gestures for note navigation.
Add a note in Projects about the accessibility remediation plan. Three critical WCAG issues to fix by April 15: alt text on charts, keyboard trap in editor, color contrast on sidebar.
Can you create a note in Shared documenting our open-source launch plan for the agent-protocol library? MIT license, launch with a Hacker News Show post and blog article, target Q2.
Please add a note in Projects about the Edge runtime migration plan. We need to move API routes from Node.js runtime to Vercel Edge for lower latency. Estimated effort: 1 week.
Create a note in Meetings for the legal review follow-up. The lawyer flagged we need a separate DPA for EU customers. Cost estimate: $8,000 for ToS and privacy policy updates.
Add a note in Projects about the pgvector search implementation. We're using OpenAI ada-002 embeddings (1536 dimensions) stored in Neon PostgreSQL with HNSW indexing for similarity search.
Create a note in Shared with the press kit update. New stats: 8,000+ users, 12 team members, backed by YC W24 batch. Recent press: TechCrunch feature in Feb 2026.
Please create a note in Meetings capturing today's advisory board takeaways. Marcus suggested building admin dashboard before mobile app. Priya recommended aggressive patent strategy.
Can you create a note in Meetings capturing the key decisions from today's design sprint? We settled on a card-based layout, infinite scroll, and dark mode for v2.
Please add a note in Projects about the monitoring alerts we need. Critical alerts: P99 latency > 500ms, error rate > 1%, disk usage > 90%.
Create a note in Work summarizing the partner integration requirements from the Stripe call. They need webhook signatures, idempotency keys, and test mode support.
Hey, can you create a note in Meetings for the QBR debrief? Main takeaways: Acme wants SSO by Q3, BetaCo is expanding to 50 seats, and we need to fix the CSV export bug.
Add a note in Shared with the updated remote work policy. Core hours are 10am-3pm PT, Fridays are meeting-free, all-hands moves to biweekly starting May.
Can you update the API Documentation note in Projects to add a new endpoint? We just shipped POST /api/v1/todos. Same auth and rate limits as the other endpoints.
Please update the Content Calendar Q2 note in Shared to add a new entry: June 20 — publish 'State of AI Agents 2026' report. It should go after the customer case study series.
Update the SOC2 Compliance Tracker note in Projects — we just completed the incident response plan. Please change the status to reflect that gap is now closed.
Can you add a new item to the Technical Debt Log in Projects? Item 4: Migrate from Vercel Analytics to Mixpanel (estimated 3 days).
Please update the Customer Metrics note in Projects with the latest numbers. MAU is now 7,500 (up from 6,200) and churn dropped to 3.8%.
Update the Competitor Analysis note in Projects to add a new competitor: Dust.tt — strong multi-agent orchestration, YC backed, pricing unclear.
Can you update the Brand Guidelines note in Shared? We decided to add a third banned word: 'synergy'. Also change the tagline to 'AI that respects boundaries.'
Update the Release Process note in Projects — we changed the release cadence from weekly Tuesdays to bi-weekly Tuesdays starting in April.
Please add the Slack integration to the Partnership Discussions note in Projects. We confirmed the integration partnership with Slack — launching in Q2.
Update the Onboarding Playbook note in Shared to include a Day 0 step: send welcome email with laptop setup instructions and Slack channel invites.
Can you update the Project Alpha Overview note in Projects? We've added two new milestones: API v2 launch on May 15 and mobile beta on June 1.
Please update the Project Alpha Tech Stack note to add Redis as our caching layer. We're using Redis 7.2 with a 15-minute TTL for API responses.
Update the Security Audit Notes in Projects — we fixed the XSS vulnerability in the search input. Mark item #3 as resolved.
Can you update the User Research Summary to add findings from the latest batch? 7 of 10 users want keyboard shortcuts, and 6 want a command palette.
Please update the Board Meeting Prep in Meetings to add the Q1 revenue number: $340K ARR, up from $280K last quarter.
Update the All Hands Notes in Meetings — add the engineering hiring update: 2 senior engineers starting in April, 1 more offer pending.
Can you update the Product Review note in Meetings to add the decision on search: we're going with pgvector for v1 and evaluating Pinecone for v2.
Update the Weekly Planning note in Meetings to add this week's sprint goal: ship the notification preferences UI and fix the email deliverability regression.
Can you update the Public Bio note in Shared? Add that TechFlow was featured in TechCrunch's top 50 AI startups list.
Please update the Newsletter Signup note in Shared — we hit 2,500 subscribers, growing at +200/week since the Product Hunt launch.
Update the Infrastructure Budget note in Projects with March actuals: AWS $4,200, Vercel $890, Supabase $350. Total $5,440, under the $6K budget.
Can you update the Investor Call - Sequoia note in Meetings? They want a deep dive on our retention metrics next week — add that as a follow-up item.
Please update the 1:1 with Mike note in Meetings — Mike confirmed he can lead the mobile project starting May 1, full-time.
Update the Customer Success Review note in Meetings — NPS score came back at 62, up from 54. Top request is better API documentation.
Can you update the Team Offsite Planning note in Meetings? We locked in Asilomar Conference Center, July 15-17. Budget approved at $15K.
